english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being unsure or lacking certainty about an answer, fact, or outcome.
This is the all-purpose choice for something whose truth, outcome, or clarity is not certain.
This is the all-purpose choice for being uncertain or not sure about something.
Use this when the speaker is personally uncertain or does not know exactly what something means.

examples.english: I'm uncertain whether they'll come back tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我唔肯定佢聽日會唔會返嚟。

examples.english: I'm still doubtful whether they will come back tomorrow.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 dou1 m4 hang2 ding6 keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 faan1 lai4

examples.english: I'm unsure whether he'll come back today.
examples.traditional: 我唔肯定佢今日會唔會返嚟。
